prompts: We want a 3D scene someone would keep as a wallpaper: the classic view of Mount Fuji at dusk, with the red five-tier Chureito pagoda and cherry trees in bloom, in a low poly look with some gentle motion. Deliver it as {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code and no external models or textures. It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[goal] `./scene/index.html`: low poly Mount Fuji at dusk, five-tier red Chureito pagoda, cherry trees in bloom, gentle motion.

[action] I wrote one self-contained file. It imports only three.module.js 0.170.0 from jsdelivr, plus a Google Font for a small caption. All geometry is built in code. It uses no textures, no models and no `Math.random` (a seeded generator keeps the scene identical on every load).
- **Scene:** Fuji has jagged snow, a lake with a mirrored copy of the peak, and a gradient sky with stars. The pagoda has five red tiers with dark roofs, a gold spire and stone steps. Low poly cherry trees, dusk clouds and a shore make up the rest.
- **Motion:** a slow camera drift, falling petals, drifting clouds, swaying blossom crowns, glints on the lake and twinkling stars. `prefers-reduced-motion` freezes it all.
- **Check:** I rendered it twice in headless Edge and read the screenshots. The first showed the front trees blocking the pagoda and Fuji washed out by fog. I moved the trees to the flanks, brought Fuji closer, thinned the fog, shrank the petals and dimmed the pagoda glare.

[result] The final render (`tmp/s2.png`) shows a clear Fuji with a pink snowcap against the orange-to-violet horizon, the five-tier pagoda on the left, and cherry trees framing the right. The file loaded and rendered with no failure. I did not read the console, so a warning could have gone unseen.
- **Not measured:**
  - Frame rate, since headless Edge used the software renderer.
  - Whether the animation looks smooth, since I only took still frames.
  - The Google Font. It is cosmetic and falls back to a serif if blocked.
- **Assumptions:**
  - "Classic view" means the view from the Chureito hillside toward Fuji across the lake, at sunset with stars appearing.
  - It is stylized, not a map-accurate view.
  - The caption is the Japanese text 富士 · 忠霊塔 · 黄昏, which I added as a small overlay.
- **Weaknesses:** the trees are chunky, and the pagoda sits on a plain plateau with no hillside stair run. The nearby trees are still large and cover part of the foreground.

[next] None needed. A second pass could add a hillside stair run and thin out the large foreground trees.
